M10x1.5 Metric Threaded Bolt (Simplified)

Using `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\params.json` as the task specification, build a simplified M10x1.5 hex-head bolt as a single watertight STL. Dimensions (mm):
- Hex head: across-flats 17 mm, thickness 6.5 mm, located at top (Z between 0 and 6.5 mm). The head MUST be a real 6-sided hex prism - build a regular hexagon polygon (e.g. via shapely) and extrude it.
- Shank: nominal diameter 10 mm, length 50 mm, extending downward (Z from 0 to -50 mm).
- Thread: helical thread on the shank with pitch 1.5 mm - modelled either as a sinusoidal radius modulation or a real swept triangular profile. Must complete ~33 turns along the 50 mm shank length.

Export `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.stl` (watertight manifold). A boolean union or simple concatenation of head + threaded shank is expected.

Requirements:
1. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.stl` parses and is watertight.
2. Bounding box matches 17 x 17 x 56.5 mm nominal - min(X,Y) within [16, 18] mm (across-flats approx 17), max(X,Y) within [16.5, 20.5] mm (across-corners approx 19.63), Z within 56.5 +\- 1 mm.
3. Head has exactly 6 flats: FFT of max-radius-per-angle-bin over head region yields dominant frequency 6.
4. Shank thread: FFT of radius-along-Z within a narrow azimuthal band yields dominant frequency in [28, 38] cycles (approx 33 for 50 mm \ 1.5 mm pitch).
source: ISO 68-1 metric thread profile (simplified) + ISO 4014\4017 hex-head geometry
